description: SCORE TO PICTURE: the last step of scoring a film. Lays each mixed cue (and any sound effect) on the video at its SMPTE timecode, with dialogue ducking (the lines found on the video's own soundtrack by VAD, or the spans you pass; the music dips ahead of each line and comes back after it), normalises the program to a delivery loudness (web −16, streaming −14, broadcast/ebu −23, atsc −24 LUFS, or a number; true peak under the ceiling) and muxes it onto the picture untouched (no re-encode). Returns the scored video, the printmaster WAV and the music-and-effects stem, plus a report of what it MEASURED: where each track landed (and what was cut at the film's edges), how far the music sits under the lines, and the final loudness and true peak. CPU, no credits. tracks: [{audio_url (a doseedo_mix mix_url as returned, or any public https URL) | audio_key, start_timecode (in the film's timecode) | start_s, gain_db?, role?: music|sfx, name?}], ≤ 64. Keep the production audio (default) or drop it (production_audio:"drop" — e.g. a temp score you are replacing; then pass dialogue spans to duck under). Up to 25 minutes of film per call (a reel). Async: job_id → doseedo_wait_task. Cancel: the plane has no stop for a running delivery — it runs to completion (credits spent), the job ends as canceled and its output is discarded. Only a job still queued at the plane is refunded by the plane's own failure refund.

dialogue.description: Dialogue spans [{start_s, end_s}] to duck under, instead of detecting them (use the cue sheet's dialogue, or your own).

duck.description: Dialogue ducking (on by default): depth_db (default 10), attack_ms (250: how early before a line the music is down), release_ms (700), sfx (false: duck effects too), enabled.

idempotency_key.description: Optional. Any unique string for THIS request (e.g. a UUID). Re-sending the same call with the same key after a timeout returns the same job instead of starting a second one.

loudness.description: Delivery loudness: "web" (−16 LUFS, default), "streaming" (−14), "broadcast" / "ebu" (−23), "atsc" (−24), or a LUFS number (−36…−8).

production_audio.description: keep (default) mixes the video's own soundtrack under the score; drop replaces it.

production_gain_db.description: Trim on the production audio when kept (default 0).

start_timecode.description: SMPTE timecode of the film's first frame (default: the file's own, else 00:00:00:00) — the clock the tracks' start_timecode is read on.

tracks.description: What to lay on the film, in any order.

audio_key.description: An ingest key instead of audio_url.

audio_url.description: The cue's mixed audio (doseedo_mix mix_url as returned) or any public https URL.

name.description: A label for the report, e.g. 1M3.

role.description: music (default; ducked under dialogue) or sfx (not ducked unless duck.sfx).

start_s.description: Or where it starts in seconds from the first frame.

start_timecode.description: Where it starts, in the film's timecode (HH:MM:SS:FF) — the cue sheet's start_timecode.

video_key.description: R2 ingest key of the video (the same upload doseedo_spot_video used).

video_url.description: https URL of the video, as an alternative to video_key.

name: doseedo_score_to_picture
title: Lay the score on the picture
